decisions.reason: Glazed industrial sectional doors sit at the core of the firm's established door business, and the firm has invested in tooling and catalog presence for them, so management will keep the product despite limited visibility on the website.

The insulated glazed variant fits the announced direction toward energy-efficient industrial doors, and the investment already made makes continuation likely, with weak results attributable to temporary construction-market conditions.
Its dedicated product page signals strong public commitment and centrality to the industrial door portfolio, so management will persist with it.
